paragraphs: The goal of this test plan is to ensure the quality, functionality, and reliability of VWO – Digital Experience Optimization Platform (https://app.vwo.com/), as described in the requirement recorded in Jira issue TES-1 (PRD).

VWO (Visual Website Optimizer) is an enterprise-grade Digital Experience Optimization (DXO) and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) platform that enables businesses to understand user behavior, test experiences, personalize interactions, and make data-driven decisions to improve conversion outcomes across web and mobile digital properties.

The requirement states these business objectives: improve conversion rates across key user funnels (for example sign-ups, purchases, lead forms); enable teams to test hypotheses and validate UX changes with empirical data rather than assumptions; reduce engineering dependency for experimentation and optimization workflows; and provide unified insights across testing, personalization and analytics.
The requirement defines these core features and capabilities:

scope.title: Functional Testing
points: Verify the nine functional requirements FR1 to FR9 listed in the requirement: A/B, Split & Multivariate Testing (FR1); SmartStats Engine (FR2); Visual & Code Editor (FR3); Heatmaps & Session Recordings (FR4); Audience Targeting (FR5); Real-time Reporting & Dashboards (FR6); Personalization Engine (FR7); Integration Connectors (FR8); Collaboration & Workflow Management (FR9).
Verify the two user flows in the requirement: Setting Up an A/B Test and Analyzing Behavioral Data.
Test coverage follows the priorities given in the requirement: Must (FR1, FR2, FR3, FR4, FR6), High (FR5, FR7, FR8) and Medium (FR9).

scope.title: Performance Testing
points: Verify that the system responds within 2 seconds for editing workflows (Non-Functional Requirement: Performance).

scope.title: Security Testing
points: Verify 2FA, role-based access control and activity logs (Non-Functional Requirement: Security).

scope.title: Scalability Testing
points: Verify that the system supports high visitor volumes without performance loss (Non-Functional Requirement: Scalability).
Visitor volume to be tested: Insufficient information to determine.

scope.title: Data Privacy Testing
points: Verify compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and regional data policies (Non-Functional Requirement: Data Privacy).
Which regional data policies apply: Insufficient information to determine.

scope.title: Reliability Testing
points: Verify the 99.9% uptime SLA for enterprise customers (Non-Functional Requirement: Reliability).

inclusions.title: Experimentation & Testing (FR1, FR2, FR3)
points: FR1 (Must): Verify that users can define and execute A/B, Split URL and Multivariate experiments with multiple variations.
FR2 (Must): Verify that the SmartStats engine provides Bayesian analysis for test results, and that results are statistically validated and actionable reports are generated.
FR3 (Must): Verify that experiments can be set up with both the WYSIWYG (visual) editor and the developer-level (code) editor.
Verify custom goals and metric configurations aligned with business KPIs.
Verify version previews, cross-device/cross-browser QA, scheduling and reporting, as listed for VWO Testing in the requirement.
Verify integration with analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel) for extended insights.

inclusions.title: Behavioral Insights (FR4)
points: FR4 (Must): Verify that heatmaps (click, scroll, focus) and session recordings capture user interactions.
Verify on-page surveys and feedback, and funnel analytics that identify drop-off points.

inclusions.title: Audience Targeting (FR5)
points: FR5 (High): Verify that audience segmentation based on behaviors can be enabled.
Verify audience targeting based on behaviors and attributes.

inclusions.title: Real-time Reporting & Dashboards (FR6)
points: FR6 (Must): Verify that real-time reporting and dashboards deliver up-to-date experiment analytics.

inclusions.title: Personalization (FR7)
points: FR7 (High): Verify that tailored experiences are delivered to segments.
Verify that users can be segmented by geography, behavior and demographics, and that customized content is delivered in real time.

inclusions.title: Integration Connectors (FR8)
points: FR8 (High): Verify that data syncs with external platforms.
Integrations named in the requirement: Shopify, Salesforce, Segment, Snowflake, WordPress, Drupal, CDPs and analytics systems, and tracking and reporting tools.

inclusions.title: Collaboration & Workflow Management (FR9)
points: FR9 (Medium): Verify the tools for planning and team tasks: a central planning interface, collaboration tools for distributed teams, and Kanban-style workflows for experiment backlogs.

inclusions.title: User Flow: Setting Up an A/B Test
points: Verify the flow end to end: define hypothesis and target metrics; select audience segment parameters; configure test variations (via visual or code editor); launch test and monitor progress; review SmartStats results and conclude winner.

inclusions.title: User Flow: Analyzing Behavioral Data
points: Verify the flow end to end: access the VWO Insights dashboard; generate heatmaps, record sessions, set funnels; correlate behavior insights with test outcomes; prioritize optimization ideas.

inclusions.title: Non-Functional Requirements
points: Performance: system responds within 2 seconds for editing workflows.
Security: 2FA, role-based access control, activity logs.
Scalability: support high visitor volumes without performance loss.
Data Privacy: compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and regional data policies.
Reliability: 99.9% uptime SLA for enterprise customers.

risks.mitigation: Provide robust SDKs and documentation, pre-built templates.
Use SmartStats and cross-tool validation integrations.
Onboard with guided tours, in-app support, analyst assistance.
